extraction_notes: Zener semantics preserved: the nominal reverse breakdown voltage VZ = 5.1 V is paired with the tabulated reverse test current IZT = 5 mA, not with the forward-voltage rating.

The BZX584C5V1 row gives VZ = 4.8 V minimum, 5.1 V nominal, and 5.4 V maximum at IZT = 5 mA; maximum Zener impedance ZZT = 60 ohm at IZT; maximum knee impedance ZZK = 480 ohm at IZK = 1.0 mA; and admissible Zener current IZM = 5 mA.
The BZX584C5V1 row gives maximum reverse leakage IR = 2 microA at VR = 2.0 V and Ta = 25 degC. The p. 1 maximum ratings give VF = 0.9 V maximum at IF = 10 mA and power dissipation PD = 150 mW.

The six zener-characteristic points are direct approximate graph-read observations from the visible BZX584C5V1 trace labeled 5.1 in p. 3 Fig. 1 at labeled logarithmic-current grid values; the plotted mA current axis was converted to A and no points were interpolated or synthesized. The figure states Ta = 25 degC, pulsed, and shows a PD = 150 mW envelope.
The BZX584C5V1 temperature-coefficient bounds are -2.7 to 1.2 mV/degC at IZTC, as listed on p. 2.

Capacitance is shown only as family-level typical curves in p. 3 Fig. 5 at Ta = 25 degC and f = 1 MHz, with 0 V, 1 V, and 50% of nominal VZ bias curves; no tabulated BZX584C5V1 capacitance value is provided, so capacitance is null.
No reverse-recovery-time specification or test circuit is published in the supplied datasheet, so reverse recovery is null.
The supplied datasheet covers the BZX584C2V4 through BZX584C43 family; this extraction is restricted to the BZX584C5V1 row and its labeled 5.1 V curve.
